content.rendered:
“Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him…”(1 Samuel 10 vs 1). That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional Today.

In our Focal Scripture, Samuel took a vial of oil and poured on Saul’s head. In Old Testament times, the anointing oil contained two sweeteners: The Cinnamon and the Cassia. So when Saul was anointed with oil, he was anointed with a sweetening anointing. God added sweetness to his life.

Friend, hear God’s Word: In this Year 2016, God will sweeten your life with remarkable testimonies that will warm your heart and cause you to celebrate. God will cause sweet things to happen in your life. God will bring you sweet opportunities; God will cause sweetness to surround you all year round.

The past year may have given you an unfair share of bitter experiences; Relax, this year will be different. In this Year, Sweetness will replace every bitterness of the past. Joy will replace every pain. Mourning shall give way to celebration.

Exodus 15 vs 23-25(Message Translation) wraps it beautifully, “They got to Marah, but they couldn’t drink the water at Marah, it was bitter…Moses cried out in prayer to God. God pointed him to a stick of wood. Moses threw it into the water and the water turned sweet”. So shall God sweeten every bitter area of your life in Jesus name.

Pray with me,”Lord, sweeten my life again and again in Jesus name”.

Your Tuesday shall be full of Testimonies, God is on your side!
